name: Maestro

abilityDetails.Glancing: Sıyırma vuruşları kritik olamaz, %50 azalmış hasar verir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu %100 düşer.
abilityDetails.Pierce: Blok Nüfuzunu ve Zırh Nüfuzunu belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Root: Köklenen şampiyonlar hareket edemez ama saldırabilir, bloklayabilir ve kaçabilir; özel saldırı Root'u kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): 10 nötronda tüm kritik ve ofansif yetenekleri engelleyen kaçış bonusu kazanır; 30'da yakındaki rakibe enerji hasarı verir; 40'ta (Superior Fury) kaçış pasif olur ve özel saldırılarında rakibi köklendirir. 40 nötrona ulaşmadan öldürmek şart — hiçbir şampiyon kaçışına immün değil. Özel saldırılar kaçışa takılmaz, bu yüzden özel hasarı yüksek şampiyonlar iyi. Bonus süresini kısaltan (Mojo, Kindred) veya pasif güç kazanan/çalan şampiyonlar (Sorcerer Supreme, America Chavez, Tigra, The Hood, Wong, Symbiote Supreme) da iyi seçenek.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Cosmic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Neutronium Might
Activating a Special Attack grants an additional 3 Neutronium, as well as Refresh Personal Fury Effects.
Each Neutronium also grants Maestro +[2 - 19] Block Penetration.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Şok Bağışıklığı ⚡️
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: An enhanced immune system and advanced armaments provide full Immunity to Poison, Shock, and Incinerate.
Maestro has given up his Superiority in order to become the most powerful Cosmic, gaining an extra +[2,033.6] Attack Rating against Tech Champions.

abilitySections.title: Neutronium - Max: 40
content: Maestro gains 1 Neutronium per second, disabled during Superior Rage. He gains them 25% slower against Mystic Champions.
Second Medium Attacks grant Maestro 3 Neutronium.

After being knocked down, Maestro cannot gain Neutronium for 6 seconds. This cannot be triggered again for 8 seconds after it expires. If one of Maestro's Buffs expires naturally, these durations are removed.
If one of Maestro's Buffs expires naturally, he cannot gain Neutronium for 8 seconds.
Whenever Maestro is Immune to an effect or has a Buff Nullified, gain 3 Neutronium. This has a 5 second cooldown.

abilitySections.title: ISO-8 Buffs
content: ISO-8 Buffs cannot be affected by Ability Accuracy and last for 36 seconds.
At 10 Neutronium, gain a Glancing Buff causing all incoming Basic Attacks to have a 100% chance to Glance.
At 20 Neutronium, gain a Pierce Buff of [144.74] potency.

At 30 Neutronium, gain a Cosmic Radiation Buff. While active, Opponents near Maestro take [1,016.8] Energy Damage per second. While Maestro is suffering from Atrophy, reduce the potency of the Energy Damage by 50%.
When Maestro would gain a ISO-8 Buff, retrigger all other ISO-8 Buffs from previous thresholds.

abilitySections.title: Superior Rage
content: At 40 Neutronium, Maestro enters Superior Rage and gains +[2,542] Attack Rating.
During Superior Rage, 1 Neutronium expires every second. While Maestro is suffering from Atrophy they expire 50% faster.
When entering Superior Rage, remove all personal Buffs and gain a Passive copy retaining the same potency and effects.
When knocked down during Superior Rage, Maestro loses 5 Neutronium.
Maestro cannot gain Neutronium for 6 seconds after Superior Rage ends.
Superior Rage ends when Maestro has 0 Neutronium, removing all personal Buffs, Passives, and any cooldowns for Neutronium.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Activating a Special Attack grants 2 Neutronium.
Superior Rage: On activation, inflict a Root Passive until the final hit of the Special Attack. This will not trigger while Maestro is suffering from Atrophy.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit deals a burst of [2,033.6] Energy Damage. Deal an additional burst of Energy Damage for each active personal Fury effect. As a Defender this Damage scales with Base Attack Only.
Superior Rage: This can trigger through Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, for each active ISO-8 Buff or Passive, gain a Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by +[1,220.16] for 36 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
Superior Rage: Gain Fury Passives instead of Buffs, and gain an Energy Penetration Passive causing all attacks to ignore 50% of the Opponent's current Energy Resistance for 36 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain 20 Neutronium.
Superior Rage: Inflict a Stun Debuff for 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Neutronium Might
content: Activating a Special Attack grants an additional 3 Neutronium, as well as Refresh Personal Fury Effects.
Each Neutronium also grants Maestro +[2 - 19] Block Penetration.
